Context: COMMUTATION TABLE (Effective from 1-1-2006)

The commuted amount of the pension will be restored on completion of fifteen years from the date the reduction of pension on account of commutation becomes operative in accordance with Rule 6; but if the commutation amount was paid on more than one occasion on account of upward revision of pension, the respective commuted amount of the pension will be restored on completion of fifteen years from the respective dates. - Rule 10-A.
